paper: Behaviorally Validated Corpus Mutation for Retrieval Robustness Evaluation
finding: Behavioral validation—not semantic validation alone—is the key step for constructing robust retrieval evaluation benchmarks.

missing_negative_control.note: Excluded from BER; gold removal is guaranteed by construction.

rq2_behavioral_effectiveness.note: BER excludes Missing (deterministic control). Paired metrics on construction retrievers for semantically valid mutations. Random-HN excluded from primary tables.

rq3_transferability.note: Held-out = E5-large + GTE-large on behaviorally accepted set. Challenge = ΔMRR>0 or Recall@5 drops vs clean.

rq3_random_baseline.note: Random HN = BM25-near corpus chunk. Compare challenge_rate / ΔMRR / construction_pass_rate.

appendix_ndcg.note: nDCG@5/10/20 reported for appendix only. Primary claims use MRR, Recall@k, Top-k crossing, BER, and held-out challenge rate. nDCG is not used for behavioral acceptance.
